from_speaker: one of the most-wasteful products in history
our_interpretation: The testable financial reading is approximately $1 trillion in cumulative realized spending attributable to generative AI by publication.
The post discusses infrastructure expenditure and industry financing. I read 'burned' as money spent, without silently converting it into net accounting losses.
The figure is an industry estimate, not a named company's reported accounting total.
No inception date is given, so the cumulative period has an unspecified start and ends on the post date.
The historical wastefulness ranking supplies neither a measure nor a comparison set and is not separately scored.
criteria.support_condition: A credible, reconciled industry accounting shows approximately $1 trillion of realized generative-AI expenditure through May 19, 2026, without double-counting financing and subsequent expenditure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive accounting using the same scope establishes a cumulative total materially below $1 trillion.
